note: Both sets cover the same core facts and share the same errors: the 1/4" adjacent to the support plates is bound as plate thickness even though the plates are called out 11"X3/8" (3/8" thick), and the section label B-L1a-GF is recycled as a member label, detail label and connection identifier. Set B is modestly better because it preserves the Detail C1 condition on the L4X4X5/16 member, the 1/4" weld and the B-L1a-GF reference, and binds the (2) 3/4" bolts to the angle rather than a generic 'connection'. Set A instead adds a vague 'structural member | dimension | 1/4"' and a redundant second bolt-diameter claim, while B's extra claim (Detail C1 scale) is a harmless duplicate of a correct fact.
remarks: Both sets read the '1/4"▽' markers as a slope and add invented 'top surface'/'bottom surface' conditions; the symbol is more likely a level/slope marker and the surface conditions are unsupported. The 1/4" next to '11"X3/8" CONT. SUPPORT PLATES' is a separate dimension (likely weld/gap), not plate thickness — both sets misbind it and then contradict themselves with the correct 3/8" thickness claim. Both sets omit the elevation callouts on the page (T.O. STEEL 11'-4", FIRST FLR 2'-4", GRADE LEVEL 0") and the detail callouts 1 and 8 that scope the L3X3X1/4 connections.
